description:
#Our most popular Sip ‘N Cycle takes you through the quiet and scenic northern Napa Valley. 

##Rates
 • **Adult** $250 *Ages 16 and up*
 • **Child/Teen** $200 *Ages <15*

##Time
 **10:30AM - 3:00PM**

##About

Cycle along famous vineyards and try world-renowned Napa wines while enjoying stunning valley views. Our most popular tour! This takes in the best of the best in the Napa Valley. We bike to 2 wineries, all unique in their own way, along the quiet back roads of Calistoga. We’ll stop in and get a “Grapes 101” along the way, pop in and taste wines and learn a lot about how to sip, swirl, and taste all the wines. Your guides act as a chef, wine educator, concierge, confidant and Sherpa all wrapped up in one. We then prepare a delicious wine country picnic lunch at one of the wineries. All in all we’ll travel 12 miles along mostly flat roads.


##Meeting Location
• **Logvy Community Park**
**[1745 Washington st, Calistoga]**


##Includes
 • **Use of Town bike and helmet, unlimited water, Wine Country picnic lunch, and professional local guides.**


##Wineries we may visit
 • **Chateau Montelena, Bennett Lane , Envy, Summers, Lava Vine, August Briggs, Tedeschi, Twomey, T Vine and Clos Pegase, among others.**
